title: Evaluation of a restricted function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\alpha$, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $h\in H$. The restriction of $f$ to $H$, evaluated at $h$, equals $f(h)$, where $h$ on the right is viewed as a vector in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$.
